name: dumbbell close grip shoulder press sit up
description: A sit-up that finishes with an overhead press, joining core and shoulder work in a single rep.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, palms facing in.
Press the dumbbells overhead at the top.
Lower them to your shoulders and roll back down slowly.
Keep your feet planted, or anchor them if needed.
